name: Invest System 4.5
summary: Invest System 4.5 is a trend-following expert advisor that identifies market direction using multiple moving averages and momentum indicators, entering trades in the direction of the prevailing trend. It employs systematic entry and exit rules with configurable stop-loss and take-profit levels. The EA aims to capture medium-to-long-term trend movements while filtering out short-term noise through multi-indicator confirmation.
summary_zh: Invest System 4.5是一个趋势跟踪型EA，利用多条移动平均线和动量指标识别市场方向，沿主导趋势方向入场交易。它采用系统化的入场和出场规则，配置了可调的止损和止盈水平。该EA旨在捕获中长期趋势行情，同时通过多指标确认过滤短期噪音。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用多指标趋势跟踪策略，核心概念是通过移动平均线的排列和交叉来判断市场趋势方向。入场条件通常要求价格位于关键均线之上（多头）或之下（空头），同时动量指标如MACD或RSI给予方向性确认。出场条件包括固定止盈止损、趋势反转信号触发以及均线交叉反向信号。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金比例的动态仓位计算方式。资金管理方面设有最大持仓限制和单笔风险控制参数，但对浮动亏损的保护机制可能不够完善。整体策略偏向右侧交易，在趋势确立后跟进，存在入场滞后的固有缺陷。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a multi-indicator trend following strategy, with the core concept of using moving average alignment and crossovers to determine market trend direction. Entry conditions typically require price to be above key moving averages for longs or below for shorts, combined with momentum confirmation from indicators like MACD or RSI. Exit conditions include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, trend reversal signal triggers, and opposing moving average crossover signals. Position sizing uses either fixed lot sizes or dynamic calculation based on account equity percentage. Money management incorporates maximum position limits and per-trade risk control parameters, but floating loss protection mechanisms may be insufficient. The overall strategy leans toward right-side trading, entering after trend confirmation, which inherently suffers from lagging entry signals.

parameters.description: EA魔术编号用于识别订单
parameters.description_en: EA魔术编号用于识别订单

pros: 多指标确认机制减少虚假信号，提高入场质量
参数可配置性强，用户可根据不同品种和市场环境调整
设有移动止损功能，能够锁定趋势中的浮动利润
趋势跟踪策略在单边行情中表现优异，盈利空间大
持仓数量限制有效防止过度交易
pros_en: Multi-indicator confirmation reduces false signals and improves entry quality
Highly configurable parameters allow adaptation to different instruments and market conditions
Trailing stop feature effectively locks in floating profits during trends
Trend following strategy performs exceptionally well in trending markets with large profit potential
Position count limit effectively prevents overtrading
cons: 趋势跟踪策略在震荡行情中容易频繁止损，产生连续亏损
均线系统存在固有滞后性，入场和出场信号均延迟于实际转折点
缺乏波动率自适应机制，在高波动和低波动市场中使用相同参数
未检测新K线形成可能导致同一信号重复入场
固定止损止盈未考虑ATR等动态波动指标，适应性不足
cons_en: Trend following strategy prone to frequent stop-outs in ranging markets, causing consecutive losses
Moving average system inherently lagging, both entry and exit signals are delayed from actual turning points
Lacks volatility adaptation mechanism, using identical parameters in high and low volatility environments
Missing new bar detection may cause duplicate entries on the same signal
Fixed stop-loss and take-profit do not account for dynamic volatility indicators like ATR, limiting adaptability
improvements: 增加ATR动态止损止盈计算，根据市场波动率自动调整风险参数
加入震荡行情过滤器（如ADX指标），在无趋势时暂停交易避免无效止损
实现新K线检测机制，确保每个信号只入场一次
加入资金回撤保护机制，达到最大回撤阈值时自动停止交易
improvements_en: Implement ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit calculation to automatically adjust risk parameters based on market volatility
Add ranging market filter (e.g., ADX indicator) to pause trading during trendless periods and avoid unnecessary stop-outs
Implement new bar detection mechanism to ensure each signal triggers only one entry
Add account drawdown protection that automatically stops trading when maximum drawdown threshold is reached

risk_points: 趋势反转时持仓可能承受较大浮动亏损后才被止损平仓
缺乏新K线检测可能导致同信号重复开仓增加风险敞口
固定止损在剧烈波动行情中可能被快速穿透造成滑点损失
risk_points_en: Positions may endure significant floating losses during trend reversals before being stopped out
Missing new bar detection may cause duplicate position openings on the same signal, increasing risk exposure
Fixed stop-losses may be quickly penetrated during extreme volatility, causing slippage losses
